import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { getStats } from "../api"; export default function Dashboard() { const [stats, setStats] = useState(null); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); useEffect(() => { getStats() .then((d) => setStats(d.data)) .catch(() => { }) .finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, []); if (loading) return
